assumptions.statement_zh: 总体设计范围采用仓库临时粗略边界，不是官方红线。
assumptions.statement_en: The Overall Design Area uses the repository provisional rough boundary, not an official planning boundary.
assumptions.impact: All boundary-sensitive quantities are low confidence and unsuitable for approval, ownership, investment, or statutory-control decisions; community audit #846 also records a discrepancy with an OSM-mapped park polygon without resolving which geometry is correct.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Organizer-supplied official GIS/CAD polygon becomes available.

assumptions.statement_zh: 三处重点区 polygon 仅按南北顺序和公告约面积配置；大钟寺重点区尚未锚定车站。
assumptions.statement_en: The three key-area polygons are ordered placeholders matched to announced approximate areas; the Dazhongsi area is not yet anchored to the station.
assumptions.impact: Key-area plans express transferable systems, not parcel or station engineering conclusions, following the source-level handling agreed in community issue #1029.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official key-area polygons and station/parcel base data are supplied.

assumptions.statement_zh: 官方控规、文保、道路红线、轨道、蓝线和退界几何缺失，constraints.geojson 因此保持空集合。
assumptions.statement_en: Official regulatory, heritage, road-redline, rail, blue-line, and setback geometry is unavailable, so constraints.geojson intentionally remains empty.
assumptions.impact: FAR, statutory building coverage, height, road area, setbacks, and engineering alignments remain unknown.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Approved planning conditions and constraint geometry are supplied.

assumptions.statement_zh: 缺少经核验的现状建筑轮廓、层数、质量、结构安全和使用状态。
assumptions.statement_en: Verified existing-building footprints, floor counts, condition, structural safety, and occupancy are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: The 15 building features are program modules, not surveyed buildings; no parcel-specific demolish/retain conclusion is made.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Survey, structural appraisal, and building ledger are completed.

assumptions.statement_zh: 未取得土地与建筑权属、租约、在建项目和运营边界。
assumptions.statement_en: Land/building ownership, leases, committed projects, and operating boundaries are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Locations and delivery entities are conceptual and require owner/operator agreements.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Rights, projects, and stakeholder responsibilities are confirmed.

assumptions.statement_zh: 七条道路要素仅为概念中心线，缺道路红线、断面、轨道接口、流量、停车与交通安全资料。
assumptions.statement_en: The seven road features are conceptual centerlines; road redlines, sections, station interfaces, traffic, parking, and safety data are missing.
assumptions.impact: They demonstrate route separation and continuity only, not road or station engineering.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Transport survey and official network data are supplied.

assumptions.statement_zh: 供配电、消防、给排水、通信、算力、热环境和废物暂存容量未测算。
assumptions.statement_en: Power, fire, water, drainage, telecom, compute, thermal, and waste-holding capacity has not been assessed.
assumptions.impact: Utility rooms and edge-compute interfaces are functional placeholders, not capacity commitments.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Municipal capacity survey and operator requirements are confirmed.

assumptions.statement_zh: 桥隧、地下空间、建筑改造、物流设施和景观构筑物均未完成工程可行性验证。
assumptions.statement_en: Bridges, tunnels, underground space, building renovation, logistics facilities, and landscape structures have no engineering feasibility confirmation.
assumptions.impact: All physical moves are conceptual recommendations for professional teams to deepen.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Multidisciplinary feasibility, code, and safety review is complete.

assumptions.statement_zh: 未取得投资、财政、招商、审批、采购和实施时序承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: No investment, fiscal, tenant, approval, procurement, or delivery-timing commitment has been obtained.
assumptions.impact: Phases are dependency sequences rather than approved schedules or budgets.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Sponsors, approvals, procurement routes, and funding are confirmed.

assumptions.statement_zh: 场内假定仅开展诊断、维修、校准、低风险模块更换、清洁翻新、组装和合格品复测；是否进入废弃电器电子产品“处理”或危险废物经营边界取决于产品目录、活动性质、部件状态和运营主体许可。
assumptions.statement_en: On-site work is limited to diagnosis, repair, calibration, low-risk module replacement, cleaning/refurbishment, assembly, and conformity retesting; WEEE treatment or hazardous-waste licensing depends on catalogue scope, activity, component condition, and operator authorization.
assumptions.impact: Damaged batteries, suspected hazardous components, and qualifying treatment operations are isolated and transferred to scope-matched licensed or qualified facilities with records.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Equipment inventory, waste classification, operating process, and license scope are legally reviewed.

assumptions.statement_zh: 资产护照不保存无必要的个人数据；设备日志、图像、位置和账户数据须按最小化、分权访问、擦除证明和人工复核规则另行设计。
assumptions.statement_en: Equipment passports exclude unnecessary personal data; logs, images, locations, and accounts require separate minimization, role-based access, erasure evidence, and human-review rules.
assumptions.impact: The proposal defines fields and governance gates, not a live personal-data system.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Operators, purposes, retention periods, and security assessment are confirmed.

assumptions.statement_zh: MTTR、首次修复成功率、备件满足率、再部署率、停机时间、材料回收率和单位服务年碳排尚无京张基线。
assumptions.statement_en: No Jing-Zhang baseline exists for MTTR, first-time-fix rate, spare-fill rate, redeployment rate, downtime, material recovery, or carbon per service-year.
assumptions.impact: The proposal provides definitions and collection methods only; it does not invent targets or outcomes.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: A pilot produces auditable work orders, asset histories, material flows, and energy records.

assumptions.statement_zh: 国际案例只用于提炼制度、数据和运营机制，不直接移植法律、评分、绩效或品牌。
assumptions.statement_en: International cases inform institutional, data, and operating mechanisms only; their laws, scores, performance, and brands are not transplanted.
assumptions.impact: Every borrowed principle is relabeled as a local conceptual mechanism requiring Chinese legal and professional review.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Local pilots and competent-authority guidance validate or reject each transfer.

assumptions.statement_zh: R0—R5 复役门、责任矩阵、场景合同与90天试点均为参与者编制的专业深化模板；尚无确认机构、合法场地、预算、真实设备或现场运行。
assumptions.statement_en: R0-R5 gates, responsibility matrices, scenario contracts, and the 90-day pilot are participant-authored professional handoff templates; no institution, lawful site, budget, real asset, or field operation is confirmed.
assumptions.impact: They improve accountability and transferability but do not prove implementation, safety, public acceptance, or product performance.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: A lawful pilot confirms named responsibilities, evidence retention, equipment scope, professional review, budget, and field authorization.
